package.description: Set up, monitor, and view the status of your QNAP external RAID devices.

en-US.description: Set up, monitor, and view the status of your QNAP external RAID devices.
en-US.longDescription: With the QNAP External RAID Manager you can set up, monitor, and view the status of your QNAP external RAID devices (such as the TR-004). All device events are recorded and desktop notifications will be sent if a system alert occurs.
en-US.name: QNAP External RAID Manager

zh-CN.description: 设置、监控并查看 QNAP 外接 RAID 装置的状态
zh-CN.longDescription: QNAP External RAID Manager 是专为 QNAP 的 RAID 存储外接设备 (例如：TR-004) 所设计的应用工具，让 Windows 与 Mac 使用者用来设置 RAID，并检视 RAID 及磁盘相关信息与健康状态。系统会记录装置内的所有事件，当异常状态发生时，将实时提供桌面讯息通知，让用户能立即掌握状况！

package.longDescription: With the QNAP External RAID Manager you can set up, monitor, and view the status of your QNAP external RAID devices (such as the TR-004). All device events are recorded and desktop notifications will be sent if a system alert occurs.
package.name: QNAP External RAID Manager
